methodology_notice: Forecasts are statistical extrapolations of historical reported trade values. They are not predictions of policy decisions, supply disruptions, prices, macroeconomic conditions or realised commercial outcomes.
fixture_accuracy_disclaimer: Fixture metrics are offline synthetic diagnostics only and must not be described as production accuracy.
mape_claim_note: No MAPE threshold claim is made. Fixture median MAPE is an offline synthetic diagnostic only and is not production accuracy.
